description: openmc-notebooks mgxs-part-i/ii/iii generate flux-weighted, self-shielded multigroup cross sections via MC tallies, including group-to-group scatter matrices (ScatterMatrixXS), group Chi, and HDF5 library export. njoy only has a fixed-spectrum group-collapse primitive (Mgxs::collapse, LIVE-tested to the notebook 2-group structure) and its own MGXL blob format. Needs: the GROUPR numeric group-averaging engine (currently NotPorted) and/or tally-based MGXS from outram-mc-libs, MF=6 kinematics for the scatter matrix, group-collapsed Chi, and an OpenMC HDF5 export bridge. Scaffold: tests/openmc_notebooks_data/mgxs_part_{i,ii,iii}.rs.

notes.author: teddy0@snrsi-arch-desktop
notes.content:
2026-07-15 op-3ut fleet pass ADVANCED this bead. Scatter-matrix half now LIVE: mgxs_part_i::groupr_elastic_scatter_matrix_u235 builds the group-to-group elastic scatter matrix for real U-235 ENDF/B-VIII.0 (MAT 9228) over the notebook 2-group [1e-3,0.625,2e7] eV under 1/E weight (A=233.0248) via the ported GROUPR matrix engine (op-3ut). Measured & asserted: fast-group P0 row sum 9.74251 b == vector elastic 9.74251 b (rel<1e-6, detailed balance / sum-to-vector); thermal row sum 13.9178 b vs vector 13.9373 b (0.14% leaks below floor, expected); no up-scatter (2.4e-19); GENDF mf=6 matrix section (IG2LO>0,NG2>2) round-trips. Verification-consistency on real data, NOT validated vs a real NJOY GENDF golden tape. STILL #[ignore] flux_weighted_self_shielded_mgxs: self-shielded (Bondarenko-dilution) MGXS + group Chi still need the URR PENDF feeder (op-3ut NotPorted) + a fission matrix, or transport-tally MGXS from outram-mc-libs.
2026-07-15 op-bsz fleet pass ADVANCED this bead: the self-shielded MGXS half is now LIVE. tests/openmc_notebooks_data/mgxs_part_i.rs::flux_weighted_self_shielded_mgxs is UN-IGNORED and passing on real U-235 ENDF/B-VIII.0 (MAT 9228), 2-group [1e-3,0.625,2e7] eV, 1/E weight: self-shielded total sigma_t(sigma0) via Bondarenko-dilution assembly [inf->[1071.15,35.19], 1e4, 1e2, 1e0->[429.52,14.44] b, monotone, inf~=vector avg]; group Chi [~0, 1.0] sums to 1; separable fission matrix row sums [2172.6,39.12] b == group nu*sigma_f exactly. New self_shielded_mgxs_dilution_limits_u238 LIVE shows strong-URR self-shielding (group-2 68.6->10.3 b). Scatter-matrix half already LIVE (op-3ut). REMAINING for closure: (a) validation vs a real NJOY GROUPR GENDF golden tape / openmc mgxs .ipynb outputs (cf1e5db) [op-ini]; (b) incident-energy-dependent chi(E'|E) fission matrix (MF=5) beyond the separable approx; (c) URR MF=2/MT=152 tape from UNRESR/PURR (self-shielding is currently flux-only/Bondarenko, tape-free). NOT validated vs golden tape — self-consistency only.

description:
Stale claim found 2026-08-11. docs/notes.md still describes quality_bubble_point_subcooled as "the active failing test", but cargo test --release -p tampines-steam-tables --lib --tests reports 924 passed, 0 failed, 14 ignored.

Either the test was fixed and the note never updated, or it is one of the 14 ignored and the note should say so. Determine which and correct it.

Small, but it is the same class as the Marviken claims and the op-r6ns scaffold-only drift: documentation asserting a state the code no longer has. A reader trusting that note would waste time hunting a failure that does not exist, or worse, assume other claims in the same file are equally stale.

Also worth noting from the same session: the Edwards-O Brien blowdown integration test takes 897 seconds -- nearly 15 minutes -- which is why full-suite runs kept hitting timeouts. That is expected for what it does, but it belongs in the crate testing notes so nobody reports a timeout as a failure. Compare the workspace CLAUDE.md rule added today for the TUAS natural-circulation suite.
title: tampines-steam-tables: docs/notes.md calls a passing test the active failing test
